# telnyx_messaging_number_bulk_update (Data Source)

The status of a bulk update of the messaging profile of phone numbers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `order_id` (String) Order ID to verify bulk update status.

### Read-Only

- `failed` (List of String) Phone numbers that failed to update.
- `pending` (List of String) Phone numbers pending to be updated.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `success` (List of String) Phoned numbers updated successfully.
